run_iphone_slam_node: run the Record3dSLAM node to publish iPhone camera and base pose data over ROS topics
generate_pose_stamped: create a PoseStamped ROS message from position, quaternion, and timestamp values
get_base_pose_2d: get the current 2D base pose as an array with X, Y, and yaw values
review_Record3dSLAM_class: review the Record3dSLAM class that transforms iPhone poses to robot base frame and publishes ROS topics
refactor_iphone_to_base_transform: refactor the Record3dSLAM class to use a custom transformation matrix between iPhone and robot base frames
